en.title: Dead Link Lagoon: Tombstones of Buried Information
en.premise: On the forums of Neo-Eden, an urban legend is circulating: accessing a specific address reveals fragmented glimpses of a "lost village." In reality, these are "Ghost Data"—incorporeal anomalies born from the digitized memories of a sunken settlement. As the rumors spread, the data proliferates, eroding the minds of users through their devices in the physical world. A young investigator soon discovers that the source of this anomaly is a massive server cluster connected to unknown ruins resting in the deep sea.

zh.title: 死链礁湖：埋没信息的墓碑
zh.premise: 在新伊甸的网络论坛上，流传着一个都市传说：只要访问特定的地址，就能看到“消失的村庄”的碎片景象。其真面目是曾经没入海中的集落记忆数字化后形成的无实体怪异——“幽灵数据”。随着传闻的扩散，这些数据不断增殖，并通过现实世界的终端侵蚀人们的精神。一名年轻的调查员在追踪过程中发现，该怪异的源头竟是连接至深海未知遗迹的巨大服务器群。
